features.statement: Page uses semantic landmark and sectioning elements (main, section, article) for structure rather than only header, nav and footer.
Sections open with a visible h2 heading, each underlined by a short accent-colored rule.
Layout is built with CSS grid and flexbox, giving multi-column card grids and side-by-side header and hero rows.
Typography pairs a serif body face (Georgia) with a Helvetica-style sans for headings and UI, instead of one sans family.
Headings are set in bold weight, with bold uppercase card titles in a dark accent color.
Accent color is a deep, muted steel blue, used for links, titles, bars and borders.
Page opens with a slim dark-blue utility bar holding plain text links and bordered text-size buttons.
Logo is plain bold text with a letter-spaced tagline, sharing a row with the title-case navigation without dropdown carets.
Hero is a two-column split with text on the left and a contained image card on the right.
Hero image card has rounded corners and a soft drop shadow on a pale blue gradient background.
Link lists are single-column stacks of bold accent-blue links separated by dashed rules.
Content is presented as bordered white cards with icon, title and description, on a 3 to 4 column grid.
Cards in the content feed carry a thick accent-colored left border on a pale tinted section.
Inline text links are blue with solid underlines.
Secondary calls to action are styled as italic underlined serif text links rather than tab labels or script fonts.
Page background alternates full-width bands of white, pale blue and dark slate to separate sections.
Footer is dark slate with two columns, preceded by a light blue information band.
Newsletter signup is minimal: a single email input inline with a short 'Sign up' button, and no header search.
Footer policy links are inline, title-case, underlined light-blue serif links.
Buttons are transparent with small 4px radius, not filled square or pill shapes.
Body text has generous line-height of about 1.6.
Decorative icon images use empty alt text while meaningful photos get descriptive alt text.
Page is lean: one script, no external stylesheets, minimal inline styles and few class names.
Visual effects are restrained: almost no shadows, few transitions, no transforms and no pill shapes.
Page titles use title case with an en dash separator.
Navigation and link microcopy is title case rather than all caps.
Content grid can end with an incomplete last row, leaving trailing empty columns.
Sponsor logos are small and left-aligned, accompanied by a text link.
